scope: Local single-GPU HTTP serving with genuine model inference; no production traffic or business outcome claim
fold_selection_rule: First registered L2 fold, selected before serving measurements; not selected for quality or latency
quantization: 4-bit NF4; frozen historical loader settings; runtime dependencies recorded
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU, 8151 MiB; Windows WDDM

data.source: Existing FABSA validation partition (1057 unique reviews)
data.development: First 100 reviews in deterministic seeded SHA-256 order
data.evaluation: Remaining 957 reviews, disjoint identities; engineering replay, not a new blind test
data.thresholds: Previously frozen per-method validation thresholds, unchanged
data.labels: Separate file joined only after persisted responses; never API input
data.official_test: Not used for serving development or new model selection
data.repeated_traffic: May repeat reviews for load; quality aggregates deduplicate review identities

correctness_gates.model_loading: Verify selected adapter tree against inventory and fixed tokenizer/base revision
correctness_gates.conditional_execution: Compare selected-aspect sentiment with full candidate-grid reference
correctness_gates.adapter_states: Compare few-shot scores from disabled adapter to the frozen-base loader on smoke cases
correctness_gates.batching: Compare single-request and combined-request labels and score deviations, including threshold margins

performance.unit: One complete review over all 12 supplied candidates, including selected-aspect sentiment
performance.tuning_rule: Use development input shapes and measured stability only. Select few feasible settings, log changes before expanded runs; do not tune model quality on evaluation replay
main_metrics: successful completed reviews per wall-clock second
failure and timeout rate over all scheduled requests
performance.capacity_search: Adaptive to measured single-request speed, with offered rate and achieved rate both recorded
performance.soak: Target 60 minutes at a sustainable selected configuration after smoke and capacity tests; extend only if drift or failures need diagnosis
performance.burst: Predeclared above-capacity burst followed by recovery window
performance.generator: Same-host client; report generation lag and scheduler misses

monitoring.shift_simulation: Replay normal development mix then a preselected long-review or aspect-enriched segment, restore normal mix; observe alarm and later label report without claiming real-world robustness
monitoring.confidence: Restricted softmax scores are not assumed calibrated probabilities of correctness

safety.gpu_jobs: One root-controlled GPU process at a time
safety.queue: Bounded queue and request deadlines; no unbounded accumulation
safety.thermal: Record temperatures and clock/power observations; pause and diagnose sustained thermal limits or instability
safety.existing_work: New worktree; no edits to submitted thesis, frozen metrics, checkpoints, or original master

publishing.final_report: Detailed Chinese report with limitations, figures, recommended operating point and interview wording
